name: business-stack
description: A hosted business stack for your agent: websites, booking pages, CRM, payments, email, courses, webinars and automations. Powered by AXL.

interface.shortDescription: Hosted websites, booking, CRM and more
interface.longDescription: When a task needs a hosted website, a booking page, a CRM, payments, email campaigns, a course, a webinar or automations, your agent can launch it on AXL instead of writing and hosting code. The skill connects the AXL MCP server with a browser sign-in, discovers the live operations, and returns links to review.
defaultPrompt: Set up a booking page for 30 minute intro calls.
Make a landing page for my workshop with a signup form.
Create a sales pipeline and import my contacts from this CSV.
